title: Powership Investment Electrical Director
desc:
HR Partners was established in 2017 with the mission of delivering effective and value-added solutions to its business partners through its experienced team in human resources and consultancy services. Operating as a private employment agency authorized by İŞKUR, HR Partners supports both global and local clients with expert, mid-level, and senior-level recruitment and placement, talent management, career consultancy, salary surveys, and assessment center services. The company adopts flexible and tailored approaches to meet the needs of both its business partners and candidates across all processes.
We are currently seeking a ''
Powership Investment Electrical Director
'' for our client operating in the ''
Energy sector
'' for whom we provide recruitment consultancy services.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 15 years of professional experience in electrical projects within the energy, oil & gas industries.
Strong experience in the design, engineering, installation, commissioning, and field execution of electrical projects.
Advanced technical knowledge and hands-on field experience in High Voltage (HV) systems and related project requirements.
Extensive experience in EPC projects, with strong knowledge of electrical engineering, installation, and project execution processes.
Proven experience in managing electrical subcontractors, including technical evaluations, field execution, scope coordination, and technical contract negotiations.
Experience in preparing and monitoring technical reports and project progress reports.
Experience in project budgeting, cost estimation, and budget planning.
Strong experience in the design, implementation, commissioning, and operational support of electrical and control systems for power generation facilities and power plants.
Strong team management, coordination, and leadership capabilities, with the ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and project stakeholders.
Advanced proficiency in English.
Willing and able to travel in line with project requirements.
Residing in Yalova, willing to relocate to Yalova, or able to work at the Yalova location.
Job Description
Lead the establishment and effective management of a large-scale electrical engineering organization responsible for the electrical design and investment processes of Powership projects.
Manage and oversee the electrical design of Powership projects, including defining technical specifications, applicable standards, and design requirements.
Manage the entire electrical design and engineering lifecycle, from the initial design phase through completion of the electrical engineering design package and handover to the relevant teams.
Communicate electrical designs, technical specifications, and project requirements to project, execution, and field teams; ensure proper implementation of the defined scope of work and oversee its control and follow-up.
Manage the preparation, review, and approval processes of technical specifications, control philosophies, single-line diagrams, and other relevant electrical design documentation.
Ensure technical quality, schedule compliance, and execution integrity throughout all stages, from electrical design through field implementation, and ensure that activities are carried out in accordance with established standards.
Manage procurement and subcontracting processes related to electrical and control systems, including technical evaluations, contract negotiations, subcontractor selection, and supplier coordination.
Ensure that projects are executed in line with the defined scope, budget, schedule, technical requirements, and quality standards.
Monitor overall project performance and prepare regular reports on technical, schedule, and financial progress for presentation to senior management.
Establish the organizational structure of the Electrical Investments team, identify the required areas of expertise and competencies, and lead the recruitment, development, and growth of the team.
